UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account registration, approval status, role, and Pickerwel preferences.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the dashboard.

email.description: Account email shown only to the owner and admins for approval review.

status.description: Admin approval status for account registration.

soundEnabled.description: Whether wheel tick and winner celebration sounds are enabled.

confettiEnabled.description: Whether confetti animation plays on winner reveal.

hapticsEnabled.description: Whether vibration feedback is enabled on supported devices.

reviewedAt.description: Server timestamp when registration was created or reviewed by an admin.

reviewedBy.description: UID of the admin who approved or rejected the registration.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when admin privilege was granted.

Wheel.title: Wheel
Wheel.description: A saved picker wheel owned by an approved user.

entries.description: Bounded list of up to 200 segment labels on the wheel.

paletteId.description: Color palette identifier for wheel segments.

spinCount.description: Total completed spins for this wheel.

SpinResult.title: SpinResult
SpinResult.description: A recorded spin outcome for an approved user's wheel.

id.description: Document identifier for the spin result.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who spun the wheel.

wheelId.description: Identifier of the wheel that was spun.

wheelTitle.description: Snapshot title of the wheel at spin time.

winnerColor.description: Hex color of the winning segment.

removedAfterSpin.description: Whether the winner was removed from the wheel after this spin.

Passcode.title: Passcode
Passcode.description: Admin-issued registration passcode allowing users to sign in with only a display name and no email.

code.description: Uppercase alphanumeric passcode identifier issued by an administrator.

label.description: Optional classroom or group note for the admin.

active.description: Whether this passcode currently accepts registrations.

createdBy.description: UID of the administrator who created this passcode.

PasscodeMember.title: PasscodeMember
PasscodeMember.description: Email-less user registration created using a display name and an active Admin passcode.

displayName.description: Normal display name provided at registration (no email required).

status.description: Access status controllable by an administrator.

PublicAppConfig.title: PublicAppConfig
PublicAppConfig.description: Public non-PII app display configuration managed by Administrators (e.g. Admin display name shown on the app).

adminName.description: Administrator display name shown on the application UI.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

StudentAssignment.title: StudentAssignment
StudentAssignment.description: A per-user student practice assignment shared via unique link and QR code. Private to its owner and visible to Admins.

id.description: Unguessable assignment identifier used in share link and QR code.

ownerId.description: UID of the Google user or memberId of the Passcode user who created this assignment.

ownerType.description: Account type of the assignment owner.

ownerDisplayName.description: Teacher display name shown on the student practice page (no email/PII).

title.description: Title of the student practice task.

instructions.description: Task instructions or practice prompts for students.

entries.description: Optional wheel entries (topics, questions, or names) students can spin during practice (max 200).

paletteId.description: Color palette identifier for the optional practice wheel.

allowWheelSpin.description: Whether students can spin the embedded wheel to receive a practice topic.

active.description: Whether the assignment currently accepts student practice submissions.

StudentSubmission.title: StudentSubmission
StudentSubmission.description: A student work submission attached to a specific StudentAssignment, readable only by the assignment owner and Admins.

ownerId.description: Denormalized ownerId from the parent StudentAssignment for O(1) owner-scoped listing.

studentName.description: Name of the student submitting work.

groupLabel.description: Optional class, seat, or group label.

drawnItem.description: Optional topic or item drawn from the practice wheel.

answerText.description: Student's practice answer or completed work notes.

status.description: Review status managed by the teacher or administrator.

CustomForm.title: CustomForm
CustomForm.description: A Google Forms-style custom survey, poll, or auto-graded quiz published by a registered user with a unique share link and QR code.

id.description: Unguessable form identifier used in the public respondent URL and QR code.

ownerId.description: UID of the Google user or memberId of the Passcode user who created this form.

ownerType.description: Account type of the form creator.

ownerDisplayName.description: Creator display name shown on the form header.

description.description: Optional form description shown below the title.

themeId.description: Selected visual accent theme for the form.

questions.description: Bounded list of up to 50 form question blocks.

acceptingResponses.description: Whether respondents can currently submit answers.

isQuiz.description: Whether quiz scoring and answer keys are enabled.

collectRespondentName.description: Whether the form asks for the respondent display name.

emailMode.description: Whether respondents submit without email, with optional email, or with a required email.

allowMultipleResponses.description: Whether respondents can submit another response after finishing.

shuffleQuestions.description: Whether question display order is randomized for each respondent.

confirmationMessage.description: Custom confirmation message displayed after submission.

published.description: Whether the form is live and open via its shareable link.

FormResponse.title: FormResponse
FormResponse.description: A respondent submission attached to a published CustomForm, readable only by the form owner and Admins.

ownerId.description: Denormalized ownerId from the parent CustomForm for O(1) owner-scoped listing.

respondentEmail.description: Optional respondent email when email collection is enabled.

answers.description: Bounded list of up to 50 answer entries ({ questionId, answerText }).

score.description: Auto-graded quiz score earned (0 if not a quiz).

maxScore.description: Maximum possible quiz score (0 if not a quiz).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user registration requests, approval status, role, and preferences.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Stores additional admin UIDs approved by the bootstrapped administrator.

/passcodes/{codeId}.description: Stores Admin-issued passcodes for email-less user registration.

/passcodeMembers/{memberId}.description: Stores email-less user registrations verified against active Admin passcodes.

/appConfig/{docId}.description: Stores public non-PII application settings such as the Admin display name.

/users/{userId}/wheels/{wheelId}.description: Stores saved picker wheels belonging to an approved user.

/users/{userId}/spinResults/{resultId}.description: Stores spin history records belonging to an approved user.

/assignments/{assignmentId}.description: Stores per-user student practice assignments with unique unguessable share links and QR codes.

/assignments/{assignmentId}/submissions/.description: Stores student work submissions for an assignment, strictly isolated to its owner and Admins.

/forms/{formId}.description: Stores published Google Forms-style surveys and quizzes with unique share links and QR codes.

/forms/{formId}/responses/{responseId}.description: Stores respondent answers for a published CustomForm, readable only by its owner and Admins.
